node.statement: For each j with 2<=j<=p, instantiate validated node 1.2 with R_0=P_[1,j-1], R_1=P_j, R=P_[1,j], and T=Q. Validated node 1.1 supplies all hypotheses uniformly: R_0,R_1,R,T are uniformly accurate Hermitian projections, R=R_0+R_1 exactly, and R_0,R_1 are uniformly approximately orthogonal. Thus the canonical assembly map A_j:S_{P_[1,j-1],Q} direct-sum S_{P_j,Q}->S_{P_[1,j],Q} is a bounded complex-linear bijection, independently of pending nodes 1.5.1.3 and 1.5.1.4.
